title.it: Configurare un livenessProbe HTTP di base

description.it: Aggiungi un livenessProbe HTTP a un deployment esistente
description.en: Add an HTTP livenessProbe to an existing deployment

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment nginx con 2 repliche
2. Aggiungi un livenessProbe che verifica / su porta 80
3. Imposta initialDelaySeconds a 10 e periodSeconds a 5
hints: Usa kubectl create deployment --image=nginx
Modifica con kubectl edit deployment o applica un manifest
Il path httpGet si configura sotto livenessProbe
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment nginx --image=nginx --replicas=2
kubectl patch deployment nginx --type='json' -p='[{"op": "add", "path": "/spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe", "value": {"httpGet": {"path": "/", "port": 80}, "initialDelaySeconds": 10, "periodSeconds": 5}}]'
exercises.validation: kubectl describe deployment nginx | grep -A5 livenessProbe

description.it: Configura un readinessProbe che verifica una porta TCP
description.en: Configure a readinessProbe that checks a TCP port

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod redis con readinessProbe tcpSocket
2. Verifica la porta 6379
3. Imposta failureThreshold a 3 e successThreshold a 1
hints: Crea un manifest YAML per il pod
tcpSocket richiede solo il numero di porta
successThreshold per readinessProbe può essere > 1
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: redis
spec:
  containers:
  - name: redis
    image: redis
    readinessProbe:
      tcpSocket:
        port: 6379
      failureThreshold: 3
      successThreshold: 1
EOF

description.it: Configura un livenessProbe che esegue un comando
description.en: Configure a livenessProbe that runs a command

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod busybox con livenessProbe exec
2. Il comando deve verificare se il file /tmp/healthy esiste
3. Imposta initialDelaySeconds a 5 e periodSeconds a 10
hints: Il probe exec esegue comandi nel container
Un comando che ritorna 0 è considerato successo
Usa 'cat /tmp/healthy' o 'test -f /tmp/healthy'
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: busybox
spec:
  containers:
  - name: busybox
    image: busybox
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'touch /tmp/healthy && sleep 3600']
    livenessProbe:
      exec:
        command:
        - cat
        - /tmp/healthy
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 10
EOF
exercises.validation: kubectl describe pod busybox | grep -A5 Liveness

description.it: Imposta parametri avanzati per i probe

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment con timeoutSeconds a 2
2. Imposta failureThreshold a 5 per livenessProbe
3. Imposta successThreshold a 2 per readinessProbe
hints: failureThreshold indica quanti fallimenti prima dell'azione
successThreshold per readiness può essere > 1
timeoutSeconds è il tempo massimo di attesa per ogni probe
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: webapp
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: webapp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: webapp
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: webapp
        image: nginx
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          timeoutSeconds: 2
          failureThreshold: 5
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          successThreshold: 2
EOF
exercises.validation: kubectl describe deployment webapp | grep -A10 liveness

description.it: Configura uno startupProbe per un'app lenta
description.en: Configure a startupProbe for a slow app

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con startupProbe
2. Il probe deve fallire per i primi 60 secondi
3. Usa periodSeconds: 10 con failureThreshold: 6
hints: startupProbe disabilita gli altri probe fino al successo
failureThreshold * periodSeconds = tempo massimo di avvio
Puoi combinare startupProbe con liveness e readiness
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: slow-start
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: nginx
    startupProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: 80
      failureThreshold: 6
      periodSeconds: 10
    livenessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: 80
      initialDelaySeconds: 0
    readinessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: 80
EOF
exercises.validation: kubectl describe pod slow-start | grep -A5 Startup

description.it: Analizza un pod con probe che falliscono
description.en: Analyze a pod with failing probes

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con livenessProbe che fallisce (porta errata)
2. Osserva il pod con kubectl get pods -w
3. Controlla gli eventi con kubectl describe
4. Identifica il motivo del restart
hints: Crea un probe su una porta inesistente (es. 9999)
Il pod entrerà in CrashLoopBackOff
kubectl events o kubectl describe mostrano i fallimenti
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: failing-probe
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
    livenessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: 9999
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 5
EOF

kubectl get pods -w &
kubectl describe pod failing-probe
kubectl get pod failing-probe -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState}'

description.it: Configura un probe con header di autenticazione
description.en: Configure a probe with authentication headers

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment con readinessProbe
2. Aggiungi header 'X-Custom-Header: test-value'
3. Aggiungi header 'Authorization: Bearer token123'
4. Verifica la configurazione
hints: httpHeaders è una lista di oggetti
Ogni header ha name e value
Gli header sono utili per endpoint protetti
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api-server
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: nginx
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 80
            httpHeaders:
            - name: X-Custom-Header
              value: test-value
            - name: Authorization
              value: Bearer token123
EOF
exercises.validation: kubectl get deployment api-server -o yaml | grep -A10 httpHeaders

description.it: Configura un probe su endpoint HTTPS
description.en: Configure a probe on HTTPS endpoint

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod che simula HTTPS
2. Configura readinessProbe con scheme: HTTPS
3. Imposta la porta 443
4. Verifica il campo scheme nel manifest
hints: Il campo scheme accetta HTTP o HTTPS
Di default è HTTP
HTTPS è utile per API protette
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: https-app
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
    readinessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: 443
        scheme: HTTPS
EOF

description.it: Configura entrambi i probe nello stesso container
description.en: Configure both probes in the same container

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment con livenessProbe e readinessProbe
2. livenessProbe: /healthz su porta 8080
3. readinessProbe: /ready su porta 8080
4. Imposta parametri diversi per ogni probe
hints: I probe possono avere path diversi
initialDelaySeconds può essere diverso
readinessProbe può avere initialDelay più alto
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: full-probe
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: full-probe
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: full-probe
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: nginx
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 10
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 3
EOF

exercises.task:
1. Crea due pod identici con restartPolicy diversa
2. Pod A: restartPolicy: Always
3. Pod B: restartPolicy: OnFailure
4. Simula un crash e osserva il comportamento
hints: Always riavvia anche per exit code 0
OnFailure riavvia solo per exit code != 0
Never non riavvia mai
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pod-always
spec:
  restartPolicy: Always
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: busybox
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'sleep 10 && exit 0']
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pod-onfailure
spec:
  restartPolicy: OnFailure
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: busybox
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'sleep 10 && exit 0']
EOF

description.it: Usa il nome della porta invece del numero
description.en: Use port name instead of number

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con porta nominata 'http'
2. Configura il probe usando il nome della porta
3. Verifica che funzioni correttamente
hints: Definisci ports con name: http
Nei probe puoi usare porta numerica o nome
Il nome porta è più manutenibile
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: named-port
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
    ports:
    - name: http
      containerPort: 80
    livenessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: http
EOF

description.it: Analizza gli eventi Kubernetes per diagnosticare probe
description.en: Analyze Kubernetes events to diagnose probes

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con probe che fallisce
2. Usa kubectl events per vedere cosa succede
3. Filtra gli eventi per tipo di probe
4. Identifica il timestamp del fallimento
hints: kubectl events --sort='.lastTimestamp'
Gli eventi hanno reason: LivenessProbeFailed
kubectl get events --field-selector reason=LivenessProbeFailed
exercises.solution:
# Crea pod con probe che fallisce
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: debug-probe
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
    livenessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /nonexistent
        port: 80
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 5
EOF

# Analizza eventi
kubectl events --for pod/debug-probe
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=debug-probe
kubectl describe pod debug-probe | grep -A10 Events
exercises.validation: kubectl get events --field-selector reason=LivenessProbeFailed -o name | wc -l

description.it: Configura un probe gRPC per verificare salute
description.en: Configure a gRPC probe to check health

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con probe gRPC
2. Configura porta 50051
3. Specifica il servizio di health opzionale
4. Imposta i parametri di timeout
hints: gRPC probe richiede Kubernetes >= 1.24
Il campo service è opzionale per health standard
Usa grpc con port e service
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: grpc-app
spec:
  containers:
  - name: grpc-server
    image: node:18
    command: ['node', '-e', 'const grpc = require("@grpc/grpc-js"); // simulate grpc server']
    ports:
    - containerPort: 50051
    livenessProbe:
      grpc:
        port: 50051
      initialDelaySeconds: 10
      periodSeconds: 5
    readinessProbe:
      grpc:
        port: 50051
        service: myapp.Health
EOF

description.it: Usa env vars per configurare dinamicamente i probe
description.en: Use env vars to dynamically configure probes

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment con variabile HEALTH_PORT
2. Configura il probe usando $(HEALTH_PORT)
3. Verifica l'espansione della variabile
hints: Puoi usare variabili nel path del probe
La sintassi è $(VAR_NAME)
Le variabili devono essere definite nello stesso container
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: env-probe
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: env-probe
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: env-probe
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: nginx
        env:
        - name: HEALTH_PATH
          value: /
        - name: HEALTH_PORT
          value: "80"
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: $(HEALTH_PATH)
            port: $(HEALTH_PORT)
EOF
exercises.validation: kubectl exec deployment/env-probe -- env | grep HEALTH

description.it: Crea un deployment completamente configurato con tutti i probe
description.en: Create a fully configured deployment with all probes

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment con startupProbe, livenessProbe, readinessProbe
2. startupProbe: 30 tentativi ogni 10s
3. livenessProbe: /healthz ogni 15s
4. readinessProbe: /ready ogni 5s
5. Imposta resources requests e limits appropriati
hints: startupProbe = failureThreshold * periodSeconds = max startup time
Usa resources per evitare OOMKilled
Ordine: startup -> liveness/readiness abilitati
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: resilient-app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: resilient
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: resilient
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: nginx
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          failureThreshold: 30
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          initialDelaySeconds: 0
          periodSeconds: 15
          timeoutSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 3
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 3
          successThreshold: 1
EOF
exercises.validation: kubectl rollout status deployment/resilient-app && kubectl get pods -l app=resilient -o wide
